trap.label: disagree with
trap.wrong: The lecturer disagrees the reading’s claim.
trap.right: The lecturer disagrees with the reading’s claim.
trap.why: Em português “discorda da afirmação” leva a. O aluno omite a preposição. Em inglês, disagree with.

fix.wrong: The lecturer agrees to the reading.
fix.right: The lecturer agrees with the reading.

fix.wrong: The reading say that bias is vivid.
fix.right: The reading says that bias is vivid.

fix.wrong: First, the lecturer argues that bias is silent, whereas the reading say not.
fix.right: First, the lecturer argues that bias is silent, whereas the reading says not.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com disagree: “The lecturer does not agree the reading.” (disagrees)
rewrite.answer: The lecturer disagrees with the reading.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com whereas: “The reading says X. The lecturer says Y.” (…, whereas…)
rewrite.answer: The reading says X, whereas the lecturer says Y.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com contradicts: “The lecturer says the opposite of the reading.”
